description: Text transform on cells in column Results using expression value.toUppercase()

expression:
jython:import re

 # standardize the spelling and format of the "Results" column
 value = value.lower()
 value = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9\s]', '', value)  # remove non-alphanumeric characters
 value = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', value)  # replace multiple spaces with a single space

 # filter out rows that do not meet the specified condition for "Risk 1 (Low)"
 if 'risk 1' in value and 'low' in value:
     return value
 else:
     return None
return value
